entry.title: Inside the U.S. Power Grid: Why It's More Resilient Than You Think

media:group.media:title: Inside the U.S. Power Grid: Why It's More Resilient Than You Think
media:group.media:description:
Could a massive blackout happen in the U.S.?
A massive blackout won't happen like it does in the movies. Unlike a chain of dominoes, the U.S. power grid can't fail as a whole because it's broken up into three interconnections.
In this episode of Lab Insider, PNNL power systems engineers explain how models they're developing help utilities predict and plan for extreme events and restore power to the nation.
Is the U.S. power grid actually one giant line of dominoes waiting to fall? We analyze why a total blackout is unlikely.
Many people fear that a single point of failure could crash the entire energy system. This video explains how the grid operates as a complex network of independent sources and facilities rather than a fragile chain. By examining the infrastructure design, you will understand the safeguards that prevent localized issues from escalating into a nationwide power grid collapse.
We break down the engineering reality behind national energy reliability to show how resilient the current electrical grid actually is. Understanding these interconnections helps clarify why cascading failures are far more difficult to trigger than common myths suggest.

entry.title: Are Batteries Actually Getting Better? The Scientific Reality

media:group.media:title: Are Batteries Actually Getting Better? The Scientific Reality
media:group.media:description:
How are batteries actually getting better?
In this episode of Lab Insider, we explain how battery improvements, from longer-lasting phones to electric vehicles with greater range, start with scientists working to solve incredibly complex problems at microscopic scales.
Join us as PNNL battery researchers explain how batteries work, what limits their performance, and how automation and AI are helping accelerate the next generation of energy storage technologies.
----------- CHAPTERS:
How much better is battery technology getting every year? We examine the scientific process behind the latest energy storage advancements.
Most improvements in energy storage originate from scientists working in controlled laboratory environments. This video analyzes the reality of annual progress in battery technology, moving past the marketing hype to look at the actual engineering milestones being achieved.
We explore the complex industrial machinery involved in battery production and provide a clearer picture of how these components are tested. By focusing on the material science and the rigorous testing phases, viewers can better understand the current limitations and the genuine leaps forward in modern energy research.
